title: Petone and Lower Hutt survey map with trig stations, 1909
credit: J. W. Davis, Chief Draughtsman, New Zealand Department of Lands and Survey
altText: Detailed 1909 survey map of Petone and Lower Hutt showing trig stations, streets and boundaries.
caption: 1909 Department of Lands and Survey map of Petone and Lower Hutt with triangulation stations, survey districts and urban streets.
context: Specific historical example of the trig controls and spatial records that were used before electronic coordinate computation. It does not depict a 1960s computer.
